notes.title: BLOODY SERVICE IS 30% OFF
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iZQMYGM.gif[/img]

Until February 15th, [u][b]BLOODY SERVICE IS 30% OFF[/b][/u] as a part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale.

This is a perfect time to grab it and experience a slasher FMV visual novel that pays homage to horror from the 70s/80s and to that whole FMV fever from the 90s!

So, what are you waiting for?

--

[i]Note: if you want to test first what are we doing with this weird horror FMV + visual novel mashup, you can download the free demo of The Parrot That Summons Demons [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1487200/The_Parrot_That_Summons_Demons/][u][b]HERE[/b][/u][/url]![/i]

notes.title: Bloody Service is an 80’s slasher inspired FMV and a visual novel, expect lots of death
notes.content:
Developer CASE has given us the very latest in interactive entertainment with Bloody Service, a throwback to classic 80's slasher movies and it's worth a look.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/12/bloody-service-is-an-80s-slasher-inspired-fmv-and-a-visual-novel-expect-lots-of-death

notes.title: Bloody Service looks like a unique FMV experience blended with a visual novel
notes.content:
More FMV goodness? Yes please. Bloody Service mixes in a visual novel with an FMV (full motion video) to bring an intriguing mix that the developer says is a "dark, wild and unsettling love letter to 80’s slashers".

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/09/bloody-service-looks-like-a-unique-fmv-experience-blended-with-a-visual-novel
